name: What are the main stages of a full kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: What are the main stages of a full kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A kitchen remodel follows an orderly sequence starting with site protection and selective demolition. Once the space is cleared to framing or subfloor, trade specialists handle rough-in plumbing and electrical modifications. Next, our crew installs drywall, repairs wall surfaces, and hangs cabinetry. After countertop fabrication and template installation, we install custom tile or marble backsplashes, followed by finish carpentry, baseboards, trim, and interior painting. The final stage involves setting light fixtures, connecting plumbing appliances, and conducting a thorough walkthrough.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves demolition, rough plumbing and electrical work, drywall, cabinet hanging, countertop and tile installation, trim, paint, and final fixture trim-out.
